title: Maker Space Visits Monthly Contribution Rollup
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=makerspace:visit
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(duration_hours) as total_metric count as events dc(member) as active_members by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarizes the monthly contribution behind maker space visits, including activity volume and active-member count.
value: Monthly rollups give you a simple stewardship view without needing to inspect every meeting or visit.
implementation: Review active-member count alongside the main metric to separate a busy month from one carried by a small core group.
visualization: Monthly chart of total visit hours and distinct active members.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the bigger monthly picture for maker space visits and how many people were involved.
